newsitem.title: GREECE: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS- MAY 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS- MAY 26.

text.p: Leading stories in the Greek general press:

--National Economy and Finance Minister Yannos Papandoniou reveals what will be included in the "small package" of measures to reform the social security and pension system in Greece. The measures will start to bite in two years' time, he says.

--Ankara must beware in case its attempt to change the status quo in the Aegean boomerangs and paves the way for a revision of the status of the Bosporus Straits, Defence Minister Akis Tsohatzopoulos says.
--Leaked plans to do away with holiday bonuses (the so-called 13th wage) have caused an outcry within the ruling party PASOK. The government has denied the reports but is letting the issue 'mature'.
--There will be a new regime governing senior high schools as of September, as the education ministry's new reforms get under way. --Maria Petrakis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
